## `project_status`

*Available in [Python](#project_status-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Prints the status of the CIDA project at `project_root`.

    If project_root is not specified, use the current working directory.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    project_status(
        project_root=None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_root` (`Path | None`) - The root directory for the project.

    <h4>Returns `<Unspecified>`</h4>
